Coverage: Curated token binding for implemented families. Unknown arity stops normalization; this is not an exhaustive Git grammar or version qualification.
VersionPolicy: Stable 2.40.x through 2.56.x; option availability and value validation remain separate.

send-email.NativeDispatch: Perl GetOptions followed by optional format-patch argument forwarding; exact curated spellings only

sh-i18n.NativeDispatch: Scriptlet positional arguments; envsubst argc dispatch is validated by its command contract

sh-i18n--envsubst.NativeDispatch: Scriptlet positional arguments; envsubst argc dispatch is validated by its command contract

sh-setup.NativeDispatch: Scriptlet positional arguments; envsubst argc dispatch is validated by its command contract

Notes: revision.c distinguishes bare --pretty from equals-only --format; optional values do not consume the following argv.
parse-options optional arguments use attached forms; required arguments consume even an option-shaped next argv.
Command profiles override inherited short options: format-patch -n and-v; branch/tag/clone/push -m/-u/-n differ.
worktree --orphan is boolean; switch --orphan requires a branch name.
notes --separator is optional attached; --stripspace and ls-files --eol are boolean.
rev-parse path-format/disambiguate use equals-bound values; config parsing stops at the first non-option key.
update-index --cacheinfo is a low-level callback: separate comma tuple OR three separate values; --cacheinfo= is explicitly disallowed by source flags.
bisect run and submodule foreach command tails are opaque external argv; no Git presentation options are removed from them.
Daemon manual options use equals-bound values; upload-pack timeout uses native parse-options required values.

SVN uses Getopt::Long gnu_getopt/no_ignore_case/auto_abbrev. Curated full spellings and one-letter aliases are bound; uncurated abbreviations fail explicitly. Perl optional values may consume the next non-option argv; ordinary Git parse-options optional values do not.
rev-parse --sq-quote is an early command mode: every later argv is quoted literally, including option-shaped strings.
Getopt::Long optional separate values follow the official Perl parser contract: https://perldoc.perl.org/Getopt::Long#Options-with-values ; GNU compatibility retains this behavior.

SVN preselects the first exact known command anywhere in raw argv, as git-svn.perl does before GetOptions. Its policy is loaded before binding preceding options. A selector interleaved between an option and its value is refused explicitly rather than rebound incorrectly.
